note: dw-git's description is an operation list, which makes it lexically strong on the verbs and lexically blind to intent. The negatives are the three skills that each own a git-adjacent moment without owning the git command itself.

positives.prompt: save what I have with a sensible message
put this up as a pull request against the default branch
bring my branch up to date with main before I carry on
park these edits somewhere so I can switch off them for a moment
start a new branch for this piece of work

negatives.prompt: is this finished and safe to merge, and what should I promote out of it first
negatives.note: Merging is the git verb, but the ask is the closing verdict — dw-land runs before the push.

negatives.prompt: look over my changes for mistakes before anything else happens
write up what we are about to build as a doc with a task list
